This outfit stays within a neat business look: a refined knit, tailored trousers and a textured tweed blazer. The overcoat, lined gloves and scarf keep you warm in the frost and snow, and the blazer adds a second warm layer for your 20-minute walk. The waterproof boots with a treaded sole give grip on snow and resist road salt, and the full-length trousers sit just at the boot so no hem drags through slush.
